In order to achieve the objectives of this procurement, EDA intends to award a Framework Contract comprising the following tasks/activities: studies, assessments, expert consultations, workshops and analytical activities related to advanced nuclear technologies, defence energy resilience, energy security, the protection of critical energy infrastructure, regulatory and licensing frameworks, fuel supply considerations, implementation pathways, cyber, hybrid and physical security aspects, and capability development activities.
